description.value:
Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 139. Category: technique. Rank 2.

Rank 2 Ki technique
Ki Cost: 12
Prerequisites: none
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: Self (150 foot line)
Chargeable?: Yes
Duration: Instantaneous
Type: Beam
The user condenses a purple ball in their hands and
then fires a beam from it.
Targets in this 5 ft wide, 150 foot long line must make
a dexterity saving throw dealing 3d8 ki damage on a fail,
half on a success.
